facts.business: Ethos Limited is India's largest luxury watch retailer with an omnichannel presence, offering a curated portfolio of 80+ premium and luxury watch brands across 100+ watch boutiques and 3 lifestyle boutiques in 34 cities.
key_risks: Existence and valuation of inventory across multiple retail outlets and third-party locations nationwide
Risk of loss including theft due to high value of watches stored across various locations

Significant judgements and estimates in provision for slow-moving or obsolete inventory based on age of products, past sales trends, future sales volumes, potential brand discontinuance, changing consumer demands and fashion trends
facts.related_party_note: Holding company KDDL Limited (manufacturer of watch components) holds 50.11% stake in Ethos Limited
